description.zh:
SDK集成方式。支持

- **automatic**：自动集成。
- **manual**：手动集成。
description.en:
The SDK integration method. Valid values:

- **automatic**: automatic integration.
- **manual**: manual integration.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh: 要监测的网页URL。若站点名为 example.com，则 Url 应为 example.com/test 或站点DNS记录名/path。
description.en: The URL of the web page to monitor. If the site name is example.com, set Url to example.com/test or site DNS record name/path.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-url-observation --site-id 123456000000 --url example.com/test --sdk-type automatic --region cn-hangzhou
